notes: TVP-AIDS promotion P2 (decision gate D0, option A): pinned to gauss-state-space release tag v2.1.0 (7d0e042, GAUSS 26.1.4+), the first tag containing 5c300b1's diffuse-phase termination fix. The shared install was already at v2.1.0 when this pin was written (installed outside this repo's sync_sslib.ps1). Before pinning, all 9 installed src files plus package.json were confirmed byte-identical to the tag after line-ending normalisation. verifiedFiles covers ALL 9 src files of v2.1.0 plus package.json: sha256 of the installed (CRLF) files as found, so verify_sslib_pin.ps1 compares raw bytes, and it also flags any installed src/*.src or *.sdf file not listed here. pinnedVersion is checked against the installed package.json. Boundary: lib/sslib.lcg is NOT hashed -- it is generated at install time (sync_sslib.ps1 rebuilds it with build_lcg.ps1; this install's copy came from outside that script) and byte-for-byte determinism of that catalog has not been established, so a hash would be a false-alarm source rather than a check. A stale catalog surfaces as a GAUSS undefined-symbol error, and sync_sslib.ps1 regenerates it.
